About FazerCards: Your All-in-One Platform for Digital Products Reselling

FazerCards is a B2B reseller platform that enables online stores, marketplaces, and entrepreneurs to sell digital products — gift cards, game top-ups, subscriptions, and software keys — through a single API and web dashboard. Instead of integrating with dozens of suppliers, checking availability manually, and handling order fulfillment yourself, FazerCards aggregates 10,000+ products from 1,000+ categories into one unified catalog.

Whether you run a gaming store, a gift card marketplace, or a general digital goods shop, FazerCards provides instant delivery, competitive wholesale prices, and 24/7 automated fulfillment. Our REST API allows you to create orders programmatically, receive webhooks for status updates, and embed product delivery directly into your website or application. No manual processing, no stock management headaches — just connect, list products, and start selling.

The platform supports popular categories including Steam wallet codes, Roblox Robux, Discord Nitro, Xbox and PlayStation subscriptions, Spotify Premium, mobile game top-ups (PUBG, Genshin Impact, Mobile Legends), and thousands of gift cards for retail, gaming, and streaming services. All products are delivered automatically within seconds, and our dashboard lets you manage orders, track balance, and browse the full catalog without writing a single line of code.

FazerCards is built for resellers who want to scale without scaling their workload. Start with a free trial, choose a plan that fits your volume, and grow your digital products business with one platform instead of many.

  • Single API and dashboard for 10,000+ digital products across gift cards, game top-ups, and subscriptions

api-example.js
// Public API v2 — profile & plan
const profile = await fetch(`https://reseller.fazercards.com/api/v2/me`, {
  headers: {
    'X-API-Key': 'YOUR_API_KEY', // or Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
    Accept: 'application/json',
  },
}).then((r) => r.json());
// { ok: true, login, email, plan, planExpiresAt, ... }
// Gift card order (get category_id & card_id via GET /giftcards → /giftcards/cards)
const order = await fetch(`https://reseller.fazercards.com/api/v2/giftcards/order`, {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'X-API-Key': 'YOUR_API_KEY',
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    category_id: 'YOUR_CATEGORY_ID',
    card_id: 'YOUR_CARD_ID',
    quantity: 1,
  }),
}).then((r) => r.json());

Frequently Asked Questions

FazerCards gives you access to over 10,000 digital products in more than 1,000 categories. This includes gift cards (Amazon, iTunes, Google Play, retail, gaming), Steam wallet codes and game gifts, Roblox Robux, subscriptions (Xbox Game Pass, PlayStation Plus, Discord Nitro, Spotify Premium), and mobile game top-ups (PUBG, Genshin Impact, Mobile Legends, and many more). All products are delivered automatically through our API or web dashboard.
Most orders are delivered instantly — within seconds. Our automated system processes orders 24/7 with no manual intervention required. Your customers receive their codes, keys, or activation links immediately after payment. This makes FazerCards ideal for stores that need fast fulfillment and high customer satisfaction.
Our REST API is well-documented with examples, code snippets, and clear endpoints. We also provide webhooks for real-time status updates and SDKs for popular languages. If you need help, our support team assists with integration at no extra cost. You can also use the web Dashboard without any API integration — just log in, browse the catalog, and fulfill orders manually.
Yes! The FazerCards web Dashboard lets you manage orders, browse the full catalog, check balance, and fulfill purchases without writing any code. This is perfect for small stores or for testing the platform before integrating the API. Many resellers start with the Dashboard and add API integration later as they scale.
We accept crypto and cards: Binance Pay, USDT (TRC20/Tron, BEP20/BNB Smart Chain, TON, Aptos), and credit/debit cards. Payment is processed securely, balance is available immediately for ordering products. Contact us for enterprise terms or high-volume arrangements.
Yes. FazerCards offers a free 5-day trial of the Gold plan with full access to the catalog, API, and dashboard. No credit card required to start. You can test the full ordering flow, integrate the API, and evaluate the platform before committing to a paid plan.
Instead of integrating with dozens of suppliers, checking availability across different systems, and managing multiple accounts, FazerCards gives you one API and one dashboard. We aggregate suppliers behind the scenes, so you get a unified catalog, automatic stock management, and consistent pricing. This saves time, reduces errors, and lets you focus on growing your business.
FazerCards supports multiple regions and currencies. Product availability varies by region — for example, Steam top-ups are popular in CIS, while gift cards and subscriptions have global coverage. Check our catalog or contact support for specific region availability. We continuously expand our geographic coverage.
Yes. FazerCards is infrastructure for businesses that resell digital products: online stores, bots, and marketplaces. You get wholesale-style access to a large catalog, API, and dashboard — not a consumer retail checkout for one-off personal purchases.
Yes. Your bot calls our REST API from your backend (never expose your API key in the client). Create orders when the user pays you, then deliver codes or links to the user. Use webhooks to track order completion. Full details are in the API and Webhooks sections of this site (Docs menu).
Yes. You can receive outbound webhooks when order status changes so your system updates without polling. Configure URLs and verify signatures as described in the webhooks documentation.
Choose a plan (Bronze, Silver, or Gold), select Binance Pay or USDT (TRC20, BEP20, TON, or Aptos) at checkout, and complete payment. After confirmation, your balance is available to purchase products from the catalog. The blog also covers crypto payments for resellers in detail.
Retail sites sell to end consumers one card at a time. A wholesale reseller API like FazerCards gives you programmatic access to many brands and categories, bulk-oriented pricing tiers, and automation (API + webhooks) so you can resell through your own channels with your own markup.
Yes, subject to catalog availability. FazerCards includes mobile game top-ups and similar products alongside gift cards and PC/console content. Availability varies by game and region — check the [catalog](/catalog) or API catalog endpoints for current offers.
The REST API base URL is https://api.fzr.cards/api/v2. Authenticate every request with an X-Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY header (an Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY header also works). Generate the key in the reseller dashboard under Profile → API and keep it server-side only. Interactive OpenAPI/Swagger docs are at https://api.fzr.cards/public/docs.
If an order cannot be fulfilled, it is automatically failed and the wholesale amount is returned to your balance — your integration receives an order.failed (or order.refunded) webhook, so you can reverse the customer-side charge. A correctly delivered order (codes issued, or a top-up sent to the game ID and region you submitted) is final and not refundable, so always validate the player ID and region before placing the order.
